thread:
Alex (CS): Heads-up — LumenHR flagged as 'at-risk' in weekly health dashboard. Usage dropped ~55% last 2 weeks, support tickets about slow responses and mismatch on embeddings. Can we draft a short retention script?
Maria CSM: Ugh. I have the account notes — churn risk is mainly around search relevance and cost. They started a trial of a competitor feature last week.
Jamal (Success Eng): Relevance issues could come from our embedding model mismatch + older index. Did they reindex after last schema change?
Alex (CS): Not that I can see. They last reindexed 2025-11-02 per our logs.
OnboardBot: Reminder: LumenHR onboarding status = COMPLETE. Last success check = 2026-01-05.
Maria CSM: Ok quick plan: 1) short outreach + proposal to run a free reindex + quality validation 2) offer a temporary cost-optimized config (lower-cost quantized model) for 30 days 3) capture explicit feedback and score baseline for quality.
Ryan PM: +1. For the cost option we should include expected delta in latency and accuracy so AM can negotiate. Jamal can we prepare the config options and two-line caveats?
Jamal (Success Eng): I can. Suggest: a) quantized 4-bit variant with batching tweaks (estimated -40% cost, +30–60ms latency) b) same-model smaller-params variant (estimated -60% cost, quality drop depends on query type). I'll add bullet risks.
Lina (Ops): I can spin a short dedicated job to reindex and run a small eval set. ETA 48h. Need the dataset and queries from Maria.
Maria CSM: I'll pull the top 200 queries and the three failing tickets and drop them into the shared folder.
Alex (CS): Draft outreach script below — please edit.
Maria CSM: paste it here when ready.
Alex (CS): ```Hey <ContactName> — noticed a drop in usage and some ticket noise. We'd love to run a quick reindex and a free quality check to see if we can recover relevance. If you're open, we can also trial a cost-optimized config for 30 days while we tune. No commitment. Can I book a 20-min call? — Alex (CS)```
Maria CSM: Nice. Add a line offering to share concrete before/after metrics (CTR, average response time, top-10 precision).
Alex (CS): Updated: added metrics line.
Ryan PM: Can we standardize the evaluation checklist so it's consistent across accounts? Might be useful as a tiny playbook doc.
Maria CSM: Yes — propose fields: baseline metrics, tickets reproduced (Y/N), reindex steps, config applied, duration, customer sentiment.
Jamal (Success Eng): I'll provide the commands/ops steps we ran so it's reproducible. Example snippet: ```rdwctl reindex --org lumenhr --index employee-search --from-snapshot=20251102``` and ```rdwctl deploy-config --org lumenhr --profile quant4_small --traffic=10%```.
Lina (Ops): Good. I'll capture logs to S3 and link back.
Alex (CS): For negotiation: offer 30-day cost opt-in with a conditional rollback if precision drops >5%. Keeps them safe.
Maria CSM: I'll schedule the call for tomorrow 10am PT and mark task owner.
OnboardBot: Task created: "lumenhr_reindex_and_eval" assigned to Lina, due 2026-03-05.
Jamal (Success Eng): Quick note — capture embedding cosine distributions pre/post. Helps PMs quantify impact.
Ryan PM: Agreed. Also capture token counts and latency percentiles.
Alex (CS): Who will own the feedback capture doc? Want a link to paste into CRM after call.
Maria CSM: I'll own the doc. I'll also add a short checkbox list so AMs can tick items during the call.
Lina (Ops): Reindex job scheduled for 2026-03-04 03:00 UTC. Will report back here with S3 links.
Alex (CS): Thanks team. Goal: convert risk -> renewal by showing measurable gains and a safe downgrade path.
Maria CSM: I'll post the post-call notes and the customer-facing offer template in the folder. :thumbsup:
Jamal (Success Eng): I'll prepare the two config manifests and a short risk table.
Alex (CS): Perfect. Assign follow-ups: Maria = call & doc, Lina = reindex + logs, Jamal = configs & commands, Ryan = SLA/caveat language. Back here after call with decisions. :eyes:
